say:1:1029412001:0.text: Have your allies left you behind? Don't be sad...
say:1:1029412001:0.source_cn: 你是不是被同伴扔下来，别伤心——

say:2:1029412002:1.text: Who cares about them?! I'm crying because my idol... she's gone missing! She's the greatest magister in the world!
say:2:1029412002:1.source_cn: 怎么可能！我哭是因为我的偶像……我的偶像失踪了！她是天...

say:3:1029412003:1.text: She was so elegant in her blue dress and so patient with her feline familiars... But her disappearance...
say:3:1029412003:1.source_cn: 她穿着蓝裙的状态是那么优雅，对待猫使魔们也是那么有耐心...

say:4:1029412004:1.text: But the powers that be in the Syndicate don't care! They didn't even send anyone to investigate! Ohhh, my poor idol...
say:4:1029412004:1.source_cn: 黑金商会的上层，竟然一点都不在意！他们甚至都没有派人下...

say:5:1029412005:1.text: Hmm... Her description reminds me of someone...
say:5:1029412005:1.source_cn: 唔……总觉得她的这个描述让我想起来一个人……

choice_prompt:6:1029412005.text: Hmm... Her description reminds me of someone...
choice_prompt:6:1029412005.source_cn: 唔……总觉得她的这个描述让我想起来一个人……

say:7:1029412006:1.text: Yes! Illucia the Unveiler, my idol... The one I admire most in the world, the light of my life...
say:7:1029412006:1.source_cn: 没错！揭幕者伊露西卡大人，我的偶像……我在这个世界上最...

say:8:1029412007:1.text: But you, Merlin, you extinguished that light—
say:8:1029412007:1.source_cn: 但你，梅林，你熄灭了我的生命之光——
say:8:1029412007:1.male: But you, Merlin, you extinguished that light—
say:8:1029412007:1.female: But you, Merlin, you extinguished that light—

say:9:1029412010:2.text: Argh! Look out, Magister! She's coming right at you!
say:9:1029412010:2.source_cn: 呜啊！老师小心，她往你那边攻击过去了！
say:9:1029412010:2.male: Argh! Look out, Magister! She's coming right at you!
say:9:1029412010:2.female: Argh! Look out, Magister! She's coming right at you!

say:11:1029412008:1.text: No, I don't. But the one thing I do know is...
say:11:1029412008:1.source_cn: 不，我不知道。但我知道的是……
say:11:1029412008:1.male: No, I don't. But the one thing I do know is...
say:11:1029412008:1.female: No, I don't. But the one thing I do know is...

say:12:1029412009:1.text: YOU, Magister Merlin, are connected to it!
say:12:1029412009:1.source_cn: 伊露西卡大人的失踪，和你——梅林有关！
say:12:1029412009:1.male: YOU, Magister Merlin, are connected to it!
